_note: Shared contract (spec 007 contracts/question-set.md). Whichever system owns a turn asks these once and passes the answers along. Any change to wording or thresholds needs a new id.

commitment.instructions: Does the speaker of `turn` personally commit, in `turn`, to doing a specific follow-up task themselves? Hedges such as "I'll be honest" or "I'll be out", questions, and statements about what other people will do are not commitments.

owner.instructions: Who is going to do the follow-up task described in `turn`?
